title: Vegan Jackfruit Curry
description: The meaty texture of jackfruit combines with baby corn and potatoes in a coconut milk curry in this filling, weeknight-ready vegan dish.
ingredients: 1 (20 ounce) can jackfruit in brine - drained, rinsed, and cut into bite-sized pieces
2 teaspoons curry powder, or more to taste
salt and ground black pepper to taste

steps.text: Heat coconut oil in a large skillet over medium high heat. Cook and stir jackfruit until cooked through, about 5 minutes. Add onion and garlic; cook over medium heat until softened, about 6 minutes.
Stir ginger and curry powder into jackfruit; mix until flavors combine, about 2 minutes. Add vegetable broth, baby corn, and potatoes; cook until potatoes soften, 7 to 10 minutes.
Pour coconut milk into jackfruit curry and cook until fully heated, about 4 minutes. Season with salt and pepper.
